connection_condition: tab01.fld002 identifies the molecule that owns each atom; the molecule identifier is also the prefix of tab01.fld001
description: A molecule is composed of its atoms; every atom belongs to exactly one molecule and cannot exist without it.

connection_condition: tab02.fld002 identifies the molecule that owns each bond; the molecule identifier is also the prefix of tab02.fld004
description: A molecule is composed of its bonds; every bond belongs to exactly one molecule.

connection_condition: The bond identifier embeds the two endpoint atom ordinals, and the connectivity relation links each bond to its two atom endpoints
description: A bond is composed of exactly two atoms of the same molecule; a bond cannot exist without its endpoint atoms.

connection_condition: tab03.fld001 and tab03.fld006 both reference atom identifiers in tab01.fld001
description: An atom-bond incidence records one atom endpoint of a bond; each atom participates in zero or more incidences.

connection_condition: tab03.fld004 references a bond identifier in tab02.fld004
description: An atom-bond incidence records a bond through its identifier; each bond is represented by exactly two incidences.

connection_condition: Each incident bond contributes one directed incidence row with the atom as the first endpoint and one with it as the second endpoint
description: Connection count is the number of distinct bonds incident to an atom, derived by counting that atom's incident bonds once each.

connection_condition: Atoms are grouped by their molecule identifier (tab01.fld002)
description: Molecule atom count is derived by counting the atom records that belong to the molecule.

connection_condition: Bonds are grouped by their molecule identifier (tab02.fld002)
description: Molecule bond count is derived by counting the bond records that belong to the molecule.

connection_condition: Bonds are grouped by molecule identifier and bond order value
description: Bond type count is derived by counting bonds of a given order within the selected population.

connection_condition: The numerator is the count of bonds of the selected order and the denominator is the total bond count of the same population
description: Bond type share is derived by dividing a bond type count by the total bond count of the population and expressing it as a percentage.

connection_condition: Atoms are grouped by element symbol within the selected molecule population
description: Element share is derived by dividing the count of atoms of a given element by the total atom count of the population and expressing it as a percentage.

connection_condition: Bond type counts are compared per molecule
description: The dominant bond order is derived as the bond order with the largest bond type count in a molecule.

connection_condition: An atom identifier that appears in neither endpoint column of the connectivity relation has no incidence
description: An unconnected atom is derived as an atom with zero atom-bond incidence records.
A single bond is a bond order value; single bonds are the order-one subset of all bonds.
A double bond is a bond order value; double bonds are the order-two subset of all bonds.
A triple bond is a bond order value; triple bonds are the order-three subset of all bonds.
Carbon is a specific chemical element; carbon atoms are the 'c' subset of all atoms.

connection_condition: tab04.fld002 identifies the molecule whose label is stored in tab04.fld007
description: A carcinogenicity label is part of a molecule's record; the label cannot exist without the molecule and applies to the molecule as a whole.

connection_condition: Indirect: both are molecule-level attributes connected through the shared molecule identifier in tab04.fld002 and tab02.fld002
description: Carcinogenicity and bond order are both molecule-level properties; the workload asks whether bond-type patterns are associated with carcinogenicity, but no direct structural link exists beyond shared molecule identity.

connection_condition: Indirect: a bond's endpoints are atoms, and each atom carries an element symbol in tab01.fld003
description: Bond order and element are linked only through the atoms at the bond endpoints; there is no direct column reference between them.
